note: Single authority for deploy and rollback order. Phase 3 selected Candidate B; no later phase may switch this silently. Changing `selected` requires a new Phase 3 decision record.

interim.note: Additive record of state outside the units below. The interim bridge is retired; the legacy host redirect remains until the legacy decommission.

host.reason: Canonical host for ariadnev@1.0.0 installs. Stood up before the candidate-b cutover because install.sh, install.ps1, and packages/cli/src/cli/update-command.ts hardcode this domain with no environment override, so the release was uninstallable until it answered.
host.retirement: ariadnev-bridge deleted 2026-08-16 after wrangler moved the ariadnev.com and www.ariadnev.com Custom Domains to ariadnev-edge (production deploy run 31941102304, record deployment/records/production-ariadnev-1.0.0-deploy.json). Redeployable from workers/bridge/ as an emergency rollback (re-set GH_TOKEN).

legacyHostRedirect.note: Outlives ariadnev-bridge. Survives the Phase 12 cutover and is what flips 302 -> 301 once the rollback window closes. Removing it restores direct legacy serving within seconds without a deploy; verified live.

cutover.note: First-cutover rollback per firstCutover below is still available; the vcskill Worker and its bindings are unchanged.

legacyWorker.name: vcskill
legacyWorker.note: Retained first-cutover rollback target. Its secret namespace is separate from every unit below and must never be written by a deploy or rollback workflow.

units.note: Deployed first so the marketing site never links at a documentation host that does not answer yet.

Candidate B: this unit owns both the protected release routes and the marketing site assets, so it is deployed last and is the unit that takes the apex hostname at cutover. In production it can only bind ariadnev.com once the interim bridge has released it; see plans/260816-1437-ariadnev-candidate-b-cutover/phase-06-production-cutover.md.

firstCutover.note: First-cutover rollback is not a Worker-version rollback. It restores the captured legacy custom-domain and route binding map and removes or reassigns the new documentation hostname.
